description: This file contains internal utility functions for handling TypeScript compiler internals, including path resolution, glob pattern processing, and version-based configuration. It also exports a function to create internal TS functions from a TS compiler reference.

methods.name: createTsInternalsUncached
methods.description: Creates internal TypeScript functions that require a TS compiler reference, such as resolving extended config paths.

methods.name: getExtendsConfigPath
methods.description: Resolves the path to an extended tsconfig.json, handling relative, absolute, and module paths.

methods.name: isRootedDiskPath
methods.description: Checks if a given path is an absolute disk path.

methods.name: combinePaths
methods.description: Combines multiple path segments into a normalized path.

methods.name: getNormalizedAbsolutePath
methods.description: Returns a normalized absolute path given a filename and current directory.

methods.name: startsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a given prefix.

methods.name: endsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a given suffix.

methods.name: getPatternFromSpec
methods.description: Generates a regex pattern from a glob spec relative to a base path.

methods.name: getSubPatternFromSpec
methods.description: Creates a sub-pattern regex from a glob spec component.

methods.name: getNormalizedPathComponents
methods.description: Normalizes and splits a path into components.

methods.name: getPathComponents
methods.description: Splits a path into root and segments.

methods.name: reducePathComponents
methods.description: Simplifies path components by resolving '.' and '..'.

methods.name: getRootLength
methods.description: Calculates the length of the root component of a path.

methods.name: getEncodedRootLength
methods.description: Determines the root length considering URL, UNC, DOS, and POSIX paths.

methods.name: ensureTrailingDirectorySeparator
methods.description: Ensures a path ends with a directory separator.

methods.name: hasTrailingDirectorySeparator
methods.description: Checks if a path ends with a directory separator.

methods.name: isAnyDirectorySeparator
methods.description: Checks if a character code is a directory separator.

methods.name: removeTrailingDirectorySeparator
methods.description: Removes trailing directory separator from a path.

methods.name: isVolumeCharacter
methods.description: Checks if a character code is a drive letter (A-Z or a-z).

methods.name: getFileUrlVolumeSeparatorEnd
methods.description: Finds the end index of a volume separator in a file URL.

methods.name: some
methods.description: Checks if an array has elements, optionally matching a predicate.

methods.name: getUseDefineForClassFields
methods.description: Determines if 'useDefineForClassFields' should be enabled based on compiler options.

methods.name: getEmitScriptTarget
methods.description: Returns the script target version based on compiler options.
